name: CompTIA-SY0-601-Security+ Course
courseOverview: CompTIA Security+ (SY0-601) is a course designed to teach IT professionals the fundamentals of information security. The course covers everything from basic security concepts to advanced topics like identity management and vulnerability management. It provides a solid foundation in the essential security knowledge and skills necessary to develop and maintain a successful security program

name: CompTIA Network+ (N10-008) Course
courseOverview: The CompTIA Network+ (N10-008) certification is a global credential that validates the skills needed to design, manage, and troubleshoot wired and wireless devices. This certification covers the fundamental aspects of networking, including protocols, network infrastructure, network troubleshooting, and network security. It is widely recognized in the IT industry as a benchmark for initial networking jobs. This certification is used by industries to ensure their IT professionals have the ability to deploy, maintain, support, and operate networks.

name: CompTIA A+ 1101-1102 Course
courseOverview: The CompTIA A+ 1101-1102 certification is a globally recognized credential geared towards entry-level IT professionals. This certification validates their proficiency in managing, maintaining, troubleshooting, installing, and configuring basic computer hardware, software, and networking technologies - essentially, assuring employers that the certified individual has a fundamental understanding of computer systems. It is widely used by industries such as Information Technology, Computer Service, and Technical Support as a benchmark for hiring skilled employees. Its validity across various platforms like mobile and traditional devices, as well as operating systems such as IOS, Android, and Windows, makes the certification highly useful and versatile.

name: CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+) Course
courseOverview: In a growing digital business landscape, it is critical for businesses to protect their data from both internal and external vulnerabilities / threats. In this regard, it is of paramount importance for enterprises to create the required know-how and skills to remain secure and scale up operations according to the demand and business needs. And Cybersecurity skills are the need of the hour, with enterprises worldwide channeling their efforts to provide the best customer experience without compromising on security

name: CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner (CASP+)(CAS-004) Course
courseOverview: The CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner (CASP+)(CAS-004) certification is a vendor-neutral credential that validates advanced-level competency in risk management, enterprise security operations and architecture, research and collaboration, and integration of enterprise security. This certification confirms one's ability to implement critical security solutions and affects the risk mitigation strategies applied by businesses in various industries. Candidates with CASP+ certification have expertise in cybersecurity and can initiate effective security policies and frameworks. Industries utilize this certification to verify that their IT professionals are capable of securing a company’s assets, including data, network, and hardware systems, from various cyber threats
